criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: One real world; 1, 4 and 5 pass most of the showstopper test; 3 measures 3.0 to 1. Frame 8's repair holds (no mirror, glass, seam or plate, 'drawn to illustrate' present) but reads as a tablecloth over a lump with a sawtooth hem and floating wheels; 6 is a bar chart on a seamed plate; 7 a red wireframe with dark pads; 2 has blocky hub artifacts; 5's crate a flat face and unlit lamp; 9's wall a flat mid grey.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: One chassis, flood and accent; camera walk and lit against dark motif work; the value arc does not hold at 5 and 9; 6 sits outside.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every numeral traces; the round 1 scope repair holds. 'is deployed' is looser than c28's 'began deployment'; 'factory upgrades' looser than 'downtime related to factory upgrades'.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: Learns the table and Fremont; no reason given for a Texan to care; nothing actionable.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: Cover reads before type; 2 pays, 5 turns, 9 lands; 6 and 7 are side branches.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Clean; flat label hooks on 3 and 6; table language.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: New opening move and palette; floodlit world from no. 55 and taped bays from no. 56.

one_sentence_fix: Rebuild 8, 6 and 7 to the standard of frame 5's bolts.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A lump under a tablecloth; sawtooth hem; wheels hover; an uncaused roof shadow.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Hem follows the sill ending about 10 cm above the skillet in soft folds; tyres on the skillet with contact.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A bar chart on a seamed grey plate; flat groove; cast fraction 0.038.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Mill the blocks, offcut and groove into frame 3's dark slab, full bleed; taller blocks with longer casts.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Thin red wireframe; dark pads; grass in the footer.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Two near W-section columns own the left half; lit bluebonnet pads.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Crate a flat face; lamp unlit beside its pool; faint casts; slab lighter than 4.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Boxed crate turned to the flood; emissive lamp head; a narrower wedge.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Flat mid grey wall face; oval lamp shadows.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Pull the flood off the wall face; leg casts down and to the right.
